name: ponytail
description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
one_liner: A plug-in for AI coding assistants that stops them from over-building simple features, so you get one clean line of code instead of a bloated new library.
buyer: A CTO at a small SaaS company who's watched AI coding tools quietly balloon their codebase and cloud bill, and wants a guardrail that keeps AI-written code lean.
business_use_cases: A startup CTO installs it org-wide to cut AI-generated code review time, since diffs are smaller and easier to approve.
An agency billing clients for AI-assisted development uses it to keep project scope (and invoices) from creeping due to AI over-engineering.
A solo indie hacker uses it to keep their side-project codebase small enough to maintain alone.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a 'AI code discipline' audit service: scan a company's AI-generated commits and report how much bloat this tool would have prevented.
License a hosted dashboard version that tracks LOC/cost/time savings across a whole engineering org over time.

steal_this: This weekend, build a simple before/after 'AI bloat report' generator that runs this tool against a client's recent AI-assisted PRs and sells the report as a lead magnet for consulting.
